   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      6 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 23 may 2026 - 10 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _jade m_, 10 oct 2026, 1/5: "!!!! Impossible to cancel Subscription !!! SCAM no refund , app has many bugs, I've tried unsuccessfully to cancel many times my subscription without succes , always brought me back to the same page over and over again . I barely ever use the app because I had to re enter all my information every single time I wanted to use the app and it got tiring, I have contacted costumers service and they are refusing refunds or help of any kind . DO NOT BUY ANY SUBSCRIPTION FROM THIS APP , DO NOT DO IT ,"
            2. _Nick_, 5 oct 2026, 1/5: "Misleading sign-up flow with ill-thought out training plan and use cases. If user showed they have certain health issues, they still offered with harmful exercises for their condition, and Support just advising user to consult their doctor. The company refuses to issue an immediate refund. You warned. Stay away."
            3. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23 may 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
